correctness.rationale: Parseval fixes the nonprincipal squared Fourier mass at \( (v^2-1)/(4v^2) \), so expansion around \(c_v\) gives the deficit identity exactly. Fourier inversion of correlation gives the if-and-only-if difference-set condition. A second Parseval calculation gives the autocorrelation variance formula and the stated inequalities. For primes \(p\equiv3\pmod4\), the extremizer follows from the exact quadratic Gauss-sum magnitude; endpoint projection norm equality is the absolute convolution-kernel mass.
